title: Gate 9 negation leg greens on ANY nonzero exit, not only usage exit 2; stderr discarded
evidence: ci.yml:122-128 — "# the r3-N7 pin: a bogus arg must be REJECTED (usage exit 2) — if the" / "# validation ever silently accepts it (exit 0), the negation fails the" / "run: |" / "          tools/harness.sh input-parity && [ -x ./bin/harness ] && ! ./bin/harness input-parity bogus >/dev/null 2>&1" / tools/ci-local.sh:63 — "...tools/harness.sh input-parity && [ -x ./bin/harness ] && ! ./bin/harness input-parity bogus >/dev/null 2>&1" / harness/main.odin:84-88 — "if verb == "input-parity" { ... if len(rest) > 1 || (len(rest) == 1 && rest[0] != "save") { usage() }" and main.odin:230 — "os.exit(2)"
detail: The `!` leg passes for ANY nonzero exit, but the comment claims 'usage exit 2'; a crash/panic on the bogus-arg path would also pass, with stderr discarded. Exit-0 silent-accept and the 127 class are correctly caught.
recommended_fix: Assert the specific code: run ./bin/harness input-parity bogus, capture its exit code, and require it to equal 2 (usage), failing otherwise — echoing stderr on failure rather than discarding it.
